data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) encountered HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit the license file and the install script, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited all files and correctly identified them as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit LCEDA-Distribution-License.txt and lceda-pro-bin.install due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry mechanisms or fallback models for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete audits from resulting in inconclusive verdicts.

If a model fails to review critical execution files like .install scripts due to tool errors, the orchestration layer should automatically flag the run as failed and trigger a re-run rather than accepting a partial inconclusive result.
